budgetMonths: Show the previous or next month
budgetNext: Move to the next category's Budgeted amount
budgetPrevious: Move to the previous category's Budgeted amount
budgetQuickBudget: Open Quick Budget for the amount being edited
contextMenu: Open the menu for the focused item
editorCheckNumber: Fill in the next check number
editorEsc: Undo the change to a field, then cancel the edit
editorFields: Move to the next or previous field
editorMoveUp: Save and edit the transaction above, or go up a split line
editorRecurring: Save a new transaction and make it recurring
editorSave: Save and close, from any field
fullScreen: Turn full screen on or off
privacyMode: Turn privacy mode on or off
redoText: Redo typing in a text field
regions: Move to the next or previous area of the window
registerCleared: Mark the selected transactions cleared or uncleared
registerDate: Change the date of the selected transactions
registerMove: Move the selected transactions to another account
registerSelectAll: Select all transactions, or clear the selection
registerUndo: Undo a delete or move while Undo is shown
undoText: Undo typing in a text field
